authoritative.note: 人工精选的 AI 里程碑论文，不按时间限制；以原始论文、官方会议页或 Nature 页面为准。

items.title: Attention Is All You Need
items.why: 提出 Transformer，成为现代大语言模型和多模态模型的基础架构。

items.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
items.why: ResNet 残差连接解决了深层网络训练难题，是视觉与深度网络的基础工作。

items.title: Generative Adversarial Networks
items.why: 提出 GAN 对抗生成框架，深刻影响图像、视频与生成式 AI。

items.title: Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization
items.why: Adam 优化器成为深度学习训练最常用的基础算法之一。

items.title: ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
items.why: AlexNet 引爆深度学习浪潮，证明大规模神经网络与 GPU 训练的威力。

items.title: Sequence to Sequence Learning with Neural Networks
items.why: Seq2Seq 奠定神经机器翻译和序列生成的基础范式。

items.title: Neural Machine Translation by Jointly Learning to Align and Translate
items.why: 引入注意力机制，直接影响后续 Transformer 与长上下文建模。

items.title: Improving neural networks by preventing co-adaptation of feature detectors
items.why: Dropout 的代表性论文，是神经网络正则化的经典方法。

items.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
items.why: 确立预训练+微调范式，推动 NLP 进入预训练模型时代。

items.title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
items.why: GPT-3 展示规模扩展与少样本学习的涌现能力。

items.title: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
items.why: 建立参数量、数据量与计算量之间的缩放规律，成为大模型研发的重要依据。

items.title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback
items.why: InstructGPT/RLHF 让大模型从补全文本转向遵循人类指令。

items.title: Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models
items.why: Chinchilla 重新定义模型规模与训练 token 的配比。

items.title: GPT-4 Technical Report
items.why: 系统披露 GPT-4 的能力、评测与安全对齐方法。

items.title: LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models
items.why: 推动开放权重基础模型生态，成为开源大模型的重要起点。

items.title: Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models
items.why: 系统说明开放基础模型与对话模型的训练、评测和安全策略。

items.title: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report
items.why: MoE 大模型的高效训练与推理代表工作，对低成本大模型路线影响显著。

items.title: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning
items.why: 以强化学习激发推理能力的代表性工作，推动推理模型成为研究热点。

items.title: Qwen2.5 Technical Report
items.why: 覆盖多尺寸、多语言与长上下文能力的开放模型技术报告。

items.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
items.why: 提出思维链提示，显著提升大模型的复杂推理能力。

items.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
items.why: 将推理与工具行动结合，是 AI Agent 的核心基础论文之一。

items.title: Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools
items.why: 展示语言模型自主调用外部工具的可行路径。

items.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
items.why: 提出 RAG，成为知识增强、搜索问答和企业知识库的基础方法。

items.title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
items.why: DPO 简化偏好对齐流程，成为 RLHF 之外的重要对齐方法。

items.title: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback
items.why: 提出基于原则与 AI 反馈的安全对齐框架。

items.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
items.why: 低秩微调方法，大幅降低大模型适配与部署成本。

items.title: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
items.why: 重构注意力计算的显存与速度路径，成为长上下文训练基础设施。

items.title: Switch Transformers: Scaling to Trillion Parameter Models with Simple and Efficient Sparsity
items.why: 推动稀疏 MoE 架构在大模型中的规模化应用。

items.title: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces
items.why: 以选择性状态空间挑战 Transformer 的长序列计算瓶颈。

items.title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
items.why: DDPM 奠定现代扩散生成模型的理论与训练基础。

items.title: Diffusion Models Beat GANs on Image Synthesis
items.why: 证明扩散模型在图像生成质量上可以超越 GAN。

items.title: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models
items.why: Latent Diffusion/Stable Diffusion 的基础论文，推动高质量图像生成普及。

items.title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
items.why: CLIP 建立图文对比学习范式，成为多模态模型的重要基础。

items.title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale
items.why: ViT 证明 Transformer 可以成为通用视觉主干网络。

items.title: Flamingo: a Visual Language Model for Few-Shot Learning
items.why: 展示少样本视觉语言模型的跨模态推理能力。

items.title: Segment Anything
items.why: SAM 推动通用图像分割与视觉基础模型的发展。

items.title: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering
items.why: 3DGS 以实时高质量渲染推动三维重建与生成式 3D 发展。

items.title: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
items.why: NeRF 开创神经辐射场，成为三维视觉与场景重建的重要基础。

items.title: Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold
items.why: AlphaFold 2 解决长期困扰生物学的蛋白质结构预测难题。

items.title: Mastering the game of Go with deep neural networks and tree search
items.why: AlphaGo 是深度强化学习与复杂博弈结合的里程碑。

hot.note: Hugging Face Daily Papers 近 21 天按点赞、评论与时效综合排序。

items.title: TeleChat to Xing4: Advancing Frontier Agentic Models on Domestic Chips and Frameworks
items.summary: We present Xing 4, a series of large language models that extends the TeleChat lineage through coordinated advances in model architecture and training infrastructure on Ascend. This report describes the design principles and systems engineering behind the series, spanning architecture selection, large-scale pretraining, and reasoning and agentic post-training. We study how sparse activation, attention design, model depth and width, and speculative decoding balance model capacity with computation, memory access, an…

items.title: Gamer: A Generalist Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Long-Horizon Real-Time Game Agent
items.summary: Gamer is a generalist agent framework that integrates perception, memory, and multi-step reasoning, trained through continued pre-training, sparse-thinking instruction tuning, and multi-turn reinforcement learning to interact efficiently in 2D and 3D environments.

items.title: Sage S2.1 Flash Technical Report
items.summary: We introduce Sage S1.5 Flash, a 320-billion-parameter general-purpose mixture-of-experts model designed to reason over scientific evidence and act in interactive environments. Sage Sci-Perception uses dedicated encoders for molecular graphs and biological sequences and represents spectra as ordered patches of measurements. Modality-specific projectors map these representations into the input space of a shared backbone, which processes them alongside text and images. To develop the model's agent capabilities, we co…

items.title: VibePrevisBench: Evaluating Agentic Coding for 4D Scene Generation in Blender
items.summary: Controllable real-world video generation models can condition on a rendered graybox proxy video, which fixes layout, motion and camera. Coding agents can build such videos by reconstructing a 4D scene in Blender, yet no benchmark checks both these videos and the long, multi-shot scenes behind them. We introduce VibePrevisBench, a benchmark for 4D scene reconstruction: an agent turns a brief into an executable 4D scene and renders its proxy video. Its 242 tasks span four input kinds, including scripts, photos, cont…

items.title: InclusionMed: Benchmarking AI for Inclusive Healthcare
items.summary: InclusionMed is an open medical AI evaluation initiative that audits and reproduces benchmarks across healthcare roles and capabilities, revealing that model rankings and inference costs vary by context and motivating broader, context-specific evaluation.

items.title: AscendGYM: A Cost-Aware Kernel Optimization Benchmark for Real-World Workloads on Ascend NPUs
items.summary: AscendGYM provides a benchmark for assessing kernel optimization capabilities on Ascend NPUs using real-workload test cases, two evaluation modes, and a Speedup-Token Score that balances speedup against token cost.

items.title: K2-Horizon: A Frontier Fleet of Open Source Language Models
items.summary: We present K2-Horizon, a fleet of six fully open language models, from a 0.9B dense model to a 375B-A23B MoE, built for general-purpose reasoning and agentic work across math and science, software engineering, deep research, office automation, and beyond. The models lead or are competitive with strong open models of their size on agentic and coding benchmarks. On the modeling side, to strengthen reasoning, we introduce Mixture-of-Value Attention (MoVA), applying MoE to attention value projections, and softplus att…

items.title: AllocFlow: End-to-End Portfolio Trading Action Generation from Raw Market Data
items.summary: An end-to-end flow-matching framework generates joint portfolio allocations from raw multi-asset market histories via a cross-asset flow Transformer and a two-stage imitation and group-relative reinforcement learning procedure, improving risk-adjusted returns on cryptocurrency perpetual futures.

items.title: SPILLWAY: Separating Target Admission from Sanitization to Defend Tool-Using Agents against Prompt Injection
items.summary: Tool-using agents act on email, files, and payments, so an instruction hidden in a web page or a shared document can make an agent send data or money to an attacker. Many runtime defenses put a language model on the decision that lets an action through, so the decision depends on a model that may read the attacker's text and adds model calls to every step. Provenance defenses keep the model off the final check but need a model to plan or route each task first. Where an action goes can instead be read from the tool…

items.title: MIRIX-2.0: Multi-Agent Memory System
items.summary: MIRIX-2.0 is a multi-agent memory system for LLM agents that achieves high accuracy and efficiency across QA and procedural benchmarks without fine-tuning.
